description: Search this endpoint's catalog of business connectivity, voice and managed-IT services. Matches query text against service names and descriptions, with an optional exact category filter. Returns up to limit services (default 25, max 100) with id, name, category, provider and pricing; price detail depends on your access tier. Read-only; no API key needed. Pass a returned id to catalog.get, catalog.order_schema.get or quote.request.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against service name and description

name: catalog.search
